QuestInfo.name: The Miracle of Life 3
QuestInfo.0: Alpha and Beta couldn't find the mother of the mysterious egg. Hm? It moved! Better talk to Kumo, pronto!
QuestInfo.1: Kumo states that he does not believe the egg is a dragon egg.  At that moment the egg cracks, signaling that it is near birth! But it looks like it can't do it alone. Help break the egg but make sure you don't hurt the baby inside.
QuestInfo.2: Out of the egg hatched... a Baby White Tiger? Did tigers always come out of eggs?
QuestInfo.summary: Click on the #rquestionable egg#k and help it hatch

0.0: I don't think this is a Dragon's egg. The size and texture are all wrong. I should know, I've been doing this forever!
0.1: Wait! Did you see that? The egg moved! It's about to hatch, but I don't think it's strong enough to do it on its own. Will you help?

yes.0: Just peel a teeny part of the shell back so the baby can come out.

no.0: Don't be a grump! Help me out here!

npc.0: What, afraid it's going to bite you?
